title: Site functions are back on speaking terms with Netlify
summary:
A small maintenance day: Netlify exports fixed and text.pollinations.ai’s support-link logic made more precise.

Fixed a Netlify function export issue on pollinations.ai, keeping the site’s server-side plumbing deployable instead of mysteriously absent.

Updated the probability system controlling Ko-fi support-link displays, replacing a blunt switch with percentage-based behavior.
